name: diet-badges
description: Shows which diets a recipe or meal plan fits (vegan, vegetarian, pescatarian, dairy-free) as a badge on previews. Uses the cook.md nutrition service (Cook Basic or Pro).

dietBadges.vegan.description: Show Vegan when no ingredient is meat, fish, dairy, egg, honey, gelatine or another animal product.

dietBadges.vegetarian.description: Show Vegetarian when no ingredient is meat, poultry, animal fat, fish or shellfish.

dietBadges.pescatarian.description: Show Pescatarian when no ingredient is meat, poultry or animal fat.

dietBadges.dairyFree.description: Show Dairy-free when no ingredient is milk, cheese, yogurt or butter (shown next to Vegetarian or Pescatarian; Vegan already implies it).

dietBadges.extraNonVegan.description: Other words that make a recipe not vegan (e.g. bone broth), matched against ingredient names on whole words. Plurals match both ways.

dietBadges.showWhenLocked.description: Show a grey 🔒 Diet badge when your plan doesn't include nutrition data.
